messages:
Maya (architecture): Quick sync after the RFC: where should the 'request normalizer' live? edge CDN, runtime, or a lightweight infra sidecar?
Jon (eng-runtime): runtime for consistency. we can hook into the existing request pipeline and reuse canonicalization tests. fewer moving parts.
Leah (eng-infra): runtime adds rollout risk. sidecar gives infra control and lets us circuit-break without touching runtime binary.
Omar (eng-platform): SDKs are tempting but will fragment telemetry and increase support load. unified server-side is preferable.
Tess (eng-ml): be careful about token handling. normalizer must not alter stop sequences or instruction framing. edge rewrites have caused truncation in the past.
Jon (eng-runtime): agree. runtime normalizer can validate token boundaries and run model-preserving asserts.
Leah (eng-infra): ops asks for tenant-level opt-out header and a bypass switch. plus a phased rollout plan (staging 5%, canary region, then global).
Maya (architecture): propose primary placement = runtime (feature-flagged). secondary = infra-sidecar for opt-in tenants. SDK helpers only for best-effort normalization.
Omar (eng-platform): we need a tiny observability contract: compat.normalizer="runtime|sidecar|sdk" and compat.mapping_version tag. platform will add dashboards.
Tess (eng-ml): for debugging, store hash(original_request) + original_version_id instead of full prompts to avoid PII exposure.
Jon (eng-runtime): mapping-as-code idea: simple YAML that describes transformations. runtime can precompile those rules. example:
```
- from: v1.chat
  to: v2.chat.stream
  steps:
    - rename: messages=>history
    - inject: metadata.client_version = header(Client-Version)
```
Leah (eng-infra): sidecar runbook: metrics, healthchecks, and a bypass header. ops will own tenant opt-outs.
Maya (architecture): next steps: Jon draft runtime prototype + mapping loader, Leah write sidecar ops runbook, Omar implement metric tags, Tess prepare golden prompt suite. reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: Feature flag created: feature.request_normalizer (expiry 90d)
Omar (eng-platform): I'll baseline current latency and error-rate to compare during rollout.
Jon (eng-runtime): starting PR, will link to RFC and ping reviewers.
Maya (architecture): thanks all.
